phases.phase1: MVP implemented: CLI, verifier, kernel loader, bounded context builder, execution compiler, provider adapter, streaming/JSON renderer, last-run audit
phases.phase2: Configuration (.airborne.toml), profiles, deterministic relevance ranking, content-hash index/cache, secret detection/redaction, richer structured finding schema, provider conformance tests
phases.phase3: Typed read-only tools (fs.read, fs.search, git.status, git.diff, symbols) with capability classification, timeouts, schemas, and audit events
phases.phase4: Explicit authorized ACT envelope, additional providers, signed release packaging, Homebrew

governance.precedence: runtime security policy > UNICAGD governance > profile > user instruction > project content
